echo "Waiting for SeaweedFS S3 endpoint $${S3_ENDPOINT}..."

until aws \
  --endpoint-url "$${S3_ENDPOINT}" \
  s3api list-buckets \
  >/dev/null 2>&1
do
  sleep 5
done

echo "Ensuring bucket $${S3_BUCKET} exists..."

aws \
  --endpoint-url "$${S3_ENDPOINT}" \
  s3api create-bucket \
  --bucket "$${S3_BUCKET}" \
  >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || echo "Bucket $${S3_BUCKET} already present"

aws \
  --endpoint-url "$${S3_ENDPOINT}" \
  s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration \
  --bucket "$${S3_BUCKET}" \
  --lifecycle-configuration file:///config/lifecycle.json

echo "Lifecycle configuration applied"

aws \
  --endpoint-url "$${S3_ENDPOINT}" \
  s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration \
  --bucket "$${S3_BUCKET}"
